description: Ask of a branch's diff what it took as given, down to whether what it edits should exist, and post at most three alternative approaches as one review on its PR, each inline and graded critical or optional — editing and committing nothing. The third `/polish` pass; on its own, `/five-percent [<branch|#PR>]`. Use when the operator asks what the change took for granted, or for "the five percent".
